_about: The named characters on the arena page, built into it by 10_characters.py; who they are is left to the story. figure: the author's strength on the scale of his first Titan table (Titan Warrior 0.3885, Alaarn Warrior 4.03, Ascendent 14.76); read, as the school ladder is, as odds in a duel against a plain Titan Warrior. carry: how much of that carries over against animals (a school's swordsmanship: 0.5; all of it: 1). body: the row of titan_classes.csv a blow on him is set against, since his power is not toughness. strike: how many times harder his blows land in the staging. swift: how many times a man's speed. look: how he is drawn. elusive: he cannot be surrounded, so a group meets him one at a time and its numbers count far less. nimble: against him an animal's score is multiplied by (80 kg / its mass) to this power, because a big animal cannot catch what it cannot track (1.0 was set so that he beats a T. rex about nineteen times in twenty). tactics: real log-odds added to every engagement for always striking from where they are not looking (3.2 is about 25 to 1; it was set so that ten Alaarn Warriors kill him less than once in a thousand).
